items.content_text: If you're a fan of LEGO Technic vehicles, then you don't want to miss out on this new October Prime Day deal. The LEGO Technic Peugeot 9X8 24H Le Mans Hybrid Hypercar 42156 normally retails for $199.99, but today you can get it for $139.99 with free shipping after a 30% instant discount. That averages out to 7.8 cents per brick. This is the lowest price I've seen for this set and matches the deal I saw during Prime Day in July. Save 30% Off the LEGO Technic Peugeot Hypercar LEGO set 42156 is a 1:10 replica of the Peugeot 9X8 24H hybrid electric hypercar. This set was released in 2023 at around the same time the actual car started competing in the 24-hour Le Mans endurance race . The set measures an impressive 19.5" long, 9" wide, and 5" high, which is proportional to other LEGO Technic 18+ vehicle sets. Notable features include a mini-representation of Peugeot's custom hybrid system with a V6 piston engine combined with an electric motor and battery and functional drivetrain, working suspension, and connected steering. In addition to the livery (stickers), there are glow-in-the-dark lighting elements to mimic the cool green LED "headlights" on the real Peugeot. With a total of 1,775 bricks, the Peugeot packs in a lot of detail relative to the scale without being obnoxiously tedious to build. Discounts on flagship Technic cars like these are few and far between, and they're usually limited to a small number of units and only during special events. If you're a LEGO Technic exotic car collector, this is a must-add to your collection. items.title: Classic Board Games Are Dropping to All-Time Low Prices in Amazon's Prime Day Sale
items.content_text: Amazon’s October version of Prime Day has officially kicked off, and the retailer has already dropped hefty discounts on tons of classic board games . One of the best deals brings the latest version of Catan back to its lowest-ever price, but you'll find plenty more discounts from big publishers like Asmodee and Hasbro. In other words, now's a great time to bulk up your tabletop collection and plan some fall game nights. We're Tracking the Best Board Game Deals at Amazon This Week Note: Most of these deals are exclusive to Prime members. You can sign up for that here . Some discounts are also lightning deals, meaning they will only be available for as long as stock lasts. Starting at the top, the latest version of Settlers of Catan, one of the most iconic strategy games of all time, has dropped to its lowest price of the year with a 40% discount. This resource management game is pretty accessible to any experience level, making it an easy choice for casual game nights. Other classic board games like Ticket to Ride have dropped to their lowest price since the previous Prime Day. For more veteran tabletop players, we’d recommend something like Pandemic, which features longer co-op campaigns. If you’re just looking for something quick and cheap, you can get classic Candy Land or the quick-playing Monopoly Deal card game for under $15. Themed Editions Also on Sale Amazon is also dropping deals on specific themed editions of board games. These are typically based on more casual and family-friendly versions of classic games, like the Bluey version of Monopoly Jr, offering the incentive of a franchise tie-in to bring your family to the game night table. Some of these themes also offer a little something extra for the adults, like the Duel for Middle-Earth board game we consider one of the best Lord of the Rings games money can buy. Though according to our reviewer , Matt Thrower, it’s only really worth it if you don’t already own the original 7 Wonders Duel game. Should You Wait for Lower Prices? Board games that are already on sale are unlikely to see lower prices, even during Black Friday. However, I do think we’ll see new discounts on heavy-hitters like Wingspan that are currently missing from this list. We’ve also yet to see solid deals on trading card games and tabletop franchises like Warhammer.

items.title: Hideo Kojima Acknowledges Fan-Made P.T. Port That Runs Natively on PC
items.excerpt: Hideo Kojima has acknowledged a fan-made port of P.T. that allows the game to run natively on Windows, making it playable for a wide majority of users after it was relegated to PS4 hell.
items.content_text: Hideo Kojima has acknowledged a fan-made port of P.T. that allows the game to run natively on Windows, making it playable for a wide majority of users after it was relegated to PS4 hell. P.T. released in August 2014. Standing for ‘Playable Teaser,’ it was exactly that — a short demo of what was supposed to be the next Silent Hill game helmed by Hideo Kojima and starring Norman Reedus. Unfortunately, due to Kojima’s falling out with Konami, the title was scrapped and the demo wiped from the PlayStation store in 2015. And that’s a shame, because it’s one of the most terrifying games ever made. Luckily, a dedicated fan has worked tirelessly to make P.T. playable for those who either deleted it from their PS4s or who never got a chance to play it before it got nuked. A modder by the name LoreanXavier has revived the famous horror title on PC, and he says it’s about 97% complete at the time of writing. The modder explained that this port isn’t an emulator or a remake of the game from the ground up; on his official Discord server documenting the project, he explained that he is essentially “reverse-engineering” the executable of the PlayStation 4, using the game’s original assets, as well as C++ and Vulcan, to make a version of the title that plays on PC with a dedicated Windows program. It’s a 1:1 version of P.T., with the “same house, original content and Lua scripts, loops, events, progression and ending puzzle.” It even includes the game’s voice-recognition section. “I've played through it myself. The game hasn't been turned into a different story or a new set of puzzles. Rendering is implemented for PC, and remaining graphical differences are being addressed separately. Optional enhanced graphics can change its appearance without changing the base game,” he explained. 30 minutes of gameplay for LoreanXavier’s PC port is already available to view on YouTube, and fans are already begging him to make his code open-source in the event that his project gets copystriked when it eventually releases. But what’s most exciting isn’t the fact that people will get to play P.T. sometime soon; it’s that Hideo Kojima himself retweeted an article from GameRant discussing the port, meaning that he’s not only aware of it, but seemingly endorses its existence. “The GOAT himself acknowledged my port. I am speechless. Seeing Hideo Kojima notice something I’ve poured so much time and passion into genuinely means the world to me. Thank you so much,” LoreanXavier wrote on Twitter/X in response to Kojima's retweet. Kojima is keenly aware of what his community gets up to online, and is almost constantly retweeting fan art of his games; and given that Silent Hills never got to see the light of day, it’s probably refreshing for P.T. to get a breath of new life after a decade of languishing in the ether. Kojima's next horror game, OD , is still in development. With Hunter Schafer and Sophia Lillis starring, fans are more eager than ever to experience a fully-fledged horror title from the maker of a strikingly terrifying game like P.T., and some are even convinced that the two games are somehow related .

items.title: Xbox Reportedly Secures Exclusive Cloud Streaming Rights to GTA 6, Could Make Game Playable on PC at Launch
items.excerpt: Xbox has reportedly secured exclusive streaming rights to GTA 6, possibly making the game playable on PC at launch via the cloud.
items.content_text: Xbox has reportedly secured exclusive streaming rights to GTA 6 , possibly making the game playable on PC at launch via the cloud. The Verge has reported that Xbox will be the exclusive place to stream GTA 6 via the cloud at launch, though that doesn't mean you will need an Xbox console. Xbox offers access to its cloud streaming service on a multitude of devices, including PC, smart TVs, and mobile devices. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma reportedly told employees during a recent town hall meeting that the company was planning to do something related to GTA 6 that "no other platform holder is doing." The deal will reportedly begin with the game's release in November, though it's unclear how long it will be in place. However, if true, this would mean that PC players would have the opportunity to play GTA 6 on their device through the cloud. Although it won't boast any of the performance options, modding, and other unique features native to a PC version, it is a serviceable workaround for those who don't want to wait until Rockstar releases a port. Microsoft has made some major changes in recent weeks to the number of hours Game Pass subscribers can stream their games , but The Verge notes that pay-as-you-go plans are going to be introduced in November. This will, in theory, allow users who want to play the game without access to a console to pay for timed access to GTA 6 via streaming. IGN has reached out to Rockstar Games and Xbox for comment on the matter. The deal is certainly interesting, as The Verge also recently reported that Xbox was concerned about pre-order numbers for GTA 6 on its platform. Xbox CSO Matthew Ball denied these claims and noted that the game was breaking records on the platform, saying it matched the platform's share of the console market. PlayStation also secured marketing rights to GTA 6, leading to limited-edition GTA 6 DualSense controllers . Rockstar has also promoted the game by saying footage was captured in real time on PS5 hardware. The PS5 version of the game will also boast unique features, which has led to Rockstar marketing the game with branding that says it will "play best" on PS5 . Xbox's new streaming deal appears to be its way of directly competing with PlayStation around GTA 6. Given it is exceptionally difficult to get a console right now and they cost a fortune, this may be a huge win for Xbox, so long as they can effectively get the word out to casual gamers.
items.title_en: Xbox Reportedly Secures Exclusive Cloud Streaming Rights to GTA 6, Could Make Game Playable on PC at Launch

The Lord of the Rings’ LEGO Icons set for Rivendell is the stuff of legend, and while it’s still pricey at £355.99, it’s at least discounted from its RRP of £429.99 . With 10,316 pieces, a whopping 15 minifigures, including the Fellowship and Bilbo, and a space for you to recreate the Council of Elrond, this is an amazing set.

items.title: 'This Needs to Change' — PlayStation Fan Gets PSN Account Hacked and Restored, Acknowledges Others May Not Be as Lucky
items.excerpt: PlayStation fans are questioning the security of their PSN accounts as yet another prominent community member had their account hacked and stolen.
items.content_text: PlayStation fans are questioning the security of their PSN accounts as yet another prominent community member had their account hacked and stolen. Over the weekend, a prominent member of the PlayStation community, known as RealRadec, claimed that his PSN account had been hacked . He noted that the hackers had changed his login info, including his email, effectively locking him out of his account. He also stated that the PlayStation support phone number (which is somewhat infamous for being unhelpful anyways) was offline, leaving him without anyone to contact for assistance. The situation mirrored one that happened to noted PlayStation podcaster and ex-IGNer Colin Moriarty earlier this summer. Moriarty had his PSN account stolen from him during a livestream, prompting some panic. However, given Moriarty's status in the PlayStation community, he was able to raise a lot of noise and receive assistance from various connections at Sony. Moriarty confirmed during a stream on Monday that he lent that same assistance to Radec, as the two have collaborated on Moriarty's podcasting network, Last Stand Media. This all led to Radec getting his account back, but he was quick to note that he may not have been as lucky if he didn't have a platform and connections. "It would be foolish of me not to acknowledge that this was dealt with as quickly as possible because of the position I'm in," said Radec . "Not many people have that reach, and I am fully aware of that. This is a problem that has been brewing for a long time now at PlayStation. No one deserves to have their account stolen from them and lose access to all of their games, DLC, save data, trophies, etc. It's not right. This needs to change." Over the last few years, various PlayStation users have reported being hacked. It has also been reported that accounts are being stolen and resold online for hundreds of dollars, allowing nefarious buyers the ability to take someone else's digital games, trophies, and data. I got my account back. I want to thank everyone who reached out to me offering their assistance, advice and words of encouragement. It genuinely meant a lot. It would be foolish of me not to acknowledge that this was dealt with as quickly as possible because of the position I'm in. Not many people have that reach, and I am fully aware of that. This is a problem that has been brewing for a long time now at PlayStation. No one deserves to get their account stolen from them and lose access to all of their games, DLC, save data, trophies etc. It's not right. This needs to change. — Radec (@realradec) October 5, 2026 Moriarty reported in May that hackers can provide otherwise mundane information (dates of PSN transactions, names, birthdays, and email addresses) to PlayStation support to prove their identity and gain access to accounts. Moriarty's producer and co-host, Dustin Furman, stated at the time that someone they trusted was able to replicate this on two accounts to prove it was more than just a theory. They went on to state that this allows hackers the ability to circumvent security methods like two-factor authentication. IGN has reached out to Sony for comment on how it is combatting the situation. It's an ongoing issue, and one that has resulted in a lot of fear as we head into an all-digital era of PlayStation. items.title: Insomniac Finally Lets Players Toggle Wolverine's Story-Related Scent Trails on and Off With a 'Hint' Button
items.excerpt: In the latest patch for Marvel’s Wolverine, Insomniac has enabled the long-awaited option for players to choose whether or not they want to use the game’s visible scent trails.
items.content_text: In the latest patch for Marvel’s Wolverine , Insomniac has enabled the long-awaited option for players to choose whether or not they want to use the game’s visible scent trails by making it a togglable 'hint' option mapped to a button on their controller. The update dropped on October 6 after months of complaints from critical players, who felt the scent trails were too hand-holdy and didn’t let them explore enough on their own. On Twitter/X, Insomniac explained that their decision to make the scent trails optional was a direct result of community feedback. Now, players can choose whether or not they'd like the option to toggle them on or off by using a Hint button, which is mapped to R3 on the PlayStation 5 controller. This also goes for other features like the visibility of audio cues and nightmare roots, allowing players to navigate the game's environment and come upon the Nightmare Cabin by themselves. “Our latest update for Marvel’s #WolverinePS5 is live and adds a new ‘Hint’ toggle for story-related Scent trails based on community feedback!” Insomniac wrote . “With recent updates, you now have more control over the visibility of Scents, Audio Cues, and Nightmare Roots.” Also included in this patch were fixes for “additional community-reported issues related to crashes and bugs.” This latest update follows a similar change to scent trails that Insomniac made in late September, which gave players the option of turning off the scents for Whiskey Bottle scent trails, Material Crate Audio Clues, and Nightmare Door Roots. Prior to that, they toned down the scent trails' visibility to "make these visuals less intense" by reducing their overall opacity. Insomniac has held true to its word of improving Wolverine as time goes by. On September 15, the developer issued a message to players, saying it was "actively engaged with our player community and gathering feedback to further refine the player experience." These players have not been shy about sharing their feelings with Insomniac. Wolverine might be the developer's single most-debated game of all time, in large part due to elements like its scent trails and white paint that tell players where to go. Even Wolverine's design was a hot topic of debate, with some feeling actor Liam McIntyre didn't fit the role of Marvel's iconic short king — but McIntyre said he wasn't fazed by the criticism at all, owing to his experience in taking on the mantle of Spartacus in the mid-2010s. items.content_text: Aion 2, a free-to-play MMO action RPG, is going viral for its character creation settings — more specifically, for how busty you can make your female character. Some players sink hours into character creators before they start an RPG. They’re almost a game all on their own, and players have been known to spend inordinate amounts of time creating all manner of monstrosities using the various sliders available to them. (Check out the absolutely bonkers creations players made when Street Fighter 6 launched, for example.) However, Aion 2’s character creator is providing customization of a different type, and it has sparked quite a debate within the broader gaming community. If you’re on gaming twitter at all, you’ve probably seen gameplay footage of someone using Aion 2’s character creator — or, to put it bluntly, abusing the bust size slider to increase the size of their character’s bosom. You know, for science. This viral clip has stirred up a conversation around the types of bodies we see in video games. Some players have noticed that there doesn’t seem to be an option to decrease your character’s breast size from the default setting, leading to claims of ‘small chest erasure’ and the game’s developers catering only to a specific type of preference. “I'm sorry, but if you really ‘love boobs,’ you'd be okay with small boobs existing too, but [the] minimum size is [a] C cup?” one user wrote in a viral quote-tweet on X. おっぱい好きな気持ちは日本も海外も同じ！胸の大きさも形もいじれる“胸スライダー細かすぎ”キャラクリに注目集まる―基本無料MMO『AION 2』ついに正式サービス開始で https://t.co/P5Hfekkfyx 細かすぎるキャラクリに注目。自由自在な胸クリエイト。さらに「お腹の突出具合」まで設定可能です。 https://t.co/1uIaqM3qAK — ⚡Game*Spark⚡ (@gamespark) October 6, 2026 “I'm irritated that things like this imply only big boobs are desirable because that can give young women body image issues,” they continued in a follow-up post. Even Japanese players have noticed the disparity, with one writing , “The minimum isn't minimum at all! Even the minimum is too damn big!” “The minimum is way too big, isn’t it?” another asked . However, the broader reaction to this particular viral clip from Aion 2’s character creator has been humor; both English-speaking and Japanese players have found the bust customization feature quite funny, sparking endless jokes about how they’ll need a few hours before they “actually start the game.” Whatever the case may be, it’s at least brought some eyes to Aion 2 . Released on October 5 from South Korean developers NC, the game is set in a conflict between two warring nations. Thus far, it’s received mixed reviews on Steam, though it’s still early days and MMOs often take time for players to get settled in.

items.title: Wizards of the Coast Union Demands Company Stop Pushing Generative AI
items.excerpt: The Dungeons & Dragons and Magic: The Gathering teams at Wizards of the Coast have just announced they're unionizing, joining the Wizards of the Coast-CWA (UWOTC-CWA) union formed by the Arena team earlier this year. In a letter of demands, the union has urged Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast leaders to stop pushing generative AI.
items.content_text: The Dungeons & Dragons and Magic: The Gathering teams at Wizards of the Coast have just announced they're unionizing, joining the Wizards of the Coast-CWA (UWOTC-CWA) union formed by the Arena team earlier this year. In a letter of demands, the union has urged Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast leaders to stop pushing generative AI. The Arena team, behind the online version of Magic: The Gathering, unionized back in April, and after months, has won its union election . Now, on October 8, that union is expanding to adopt the Dungeons & Dragons team and Team X – the team behind Magic: The Gathering and Dual Masters. The Wizards of the Coast-CWA is giving the company until October 13 to voluntarily recognize the expanded unit. However, Wizards did not voluntarily recognize the union when it was just the Arena team, so this will probably be an uphill battle. The new union shared a petition ahead of its recognition, with demands it's presenting to Wizards of the Coast and Hasbro. One of those demands is protection against the encroachment of AI, where it says, "Leadership, without regard for the desires of our teams, has pushed for adoption of LLMs and generative AI. This has to stop; our teams deserve a robust and enforceable AI policy that aligns with our goals and values." Similar to another demand letter published when the union was first formed in April, UWOTC-CWA is also demanding 'Full ownership of what we create outside of work.' Back then, the union's announcement letter said, "Currently, if an employee makes anything creative in their free time, with their own resources, Hasbro may claim ownership. What we do in our free time should not be dictated by the company; neither should what we make in our free time be owned by the company." The new petition reiterates this, saying, "Wizards can currently claim ownership over any IP created by employees during their tenure at Wizards, including works that are fully unrelated to Wizards IP. What we make in our free time should belong to us, not the company." Only time will tell if Hasbro voluntarily recognizes the union, especially now that the UWOTC-CWA has already won one election. If Hasbro doesn't recognize the union, it'll have to file with the NLRB and win another election.

items.title: Death Stranding Movie Gets Update as Director Scouts Beautiful Filming Locations in Iceland
items.excerpt: The Death Stranding movie appears to be ramping up to production, as director Michael Sarnoski and cinematographer Pat Scola share a beautiful view from location scouting.
items.content_text: The Death Stranding movie appears to be ramping up to production, as director Michael Sarnoski and cinematographer Pat Scola recently shared a beautiful view from location scouting. Death Stranding director Michael Sarnoski is currently in Iceland scouting for locations that can be used for the film. He shared a selfie of himself wearing a Death Stranding T-shirt and also reposted a video from his cinematographer, Pat Scola, showcasing gorgeous Icelandic scenery featuring waterfalls and plenty of moss. It is a pretty breathtaking view, and one that perfectly replicates the kind of landscape you'd find in Death Stranding, albeit with a bit more sun. Whether or not this exact location will be used in the film remains to be seen, but it does show that the creative team behind the film understands the game's aesthetic. It's also great to see that they're going to be shooting on location, instead of relying exclusively on soundstages and CG backdrops. Sarnoski revealed earlier this summer that he plans to shoot the Death Stranding film next year in Iceland and Northern Ireland . Director Michael Sarnoski is on a location scout in Iceland for the #DeathStranding film produced by A24 and Square Peg https://t.co/Exx1PVCriv https://t.co/L9uDCxjOIm — NV (@naven0m) October 6, 2026 Sarnoski's Death Stranding will be a new, original story set within the world of the game. It has the full backing and involvement of series creator Hideo Kojima and will be produced in conjunction with A24. As a result, you can expect a new cast of characters, but Sarnoski has teased that familiar faces from the games may appear, as well . The film also comes at an interesting time, as Kojima has said he's uninterested in helming a third Death Stranding game , but would let someone else make it based on a concept he created. He's finding other ways to flesh out the world through both this film and other media, including an anime. There's currently no release date for the Death Stranding film, but a 2028 release date may not be out of the question depending on when it starts shooting next year. Cast details are also currently under wraps, but with production ramping up, we will presumably hear more on that front soon. Norman Reedus has already expressed interest in reprising his role as Sam Porter Bridges in the film , but his involvement has yet to be announced.
